title: Auto Move
description: A lightweight client-side mod that allows you to automatically walk/sprint with a simple toggle.
body:
A simple mod that allows for automated walking and sprinting. Currently, this mod supports 26.1 with Fabric 0.18.5>=, with plans to support future releases aswell. This is my first Minecraft mod and the purpose of it is to allow me to get familiar with Java and MC mod development. Apart from the Walk/Sprint toggle, there is also a config option that will auto disable the toggle if met with an obstruction, which supports Auto-Jump aswell. I'm open to feature requests aswell if anyone has any :)

Default Keybinds are:

'-': Auto Run

'=': Auto Walk



In config/automove.cfg, you can find the option to disable auto movement when obstructed by a block.
